# *Heute.at*

> *"Heute"* is an Austrian daily newspaper (print) and *Heute.at* is its news website. Founded on 6 September 2004. Based in Vienna, Austria.

This file: https://www.heute.at/llms.txt
Identical copy: https://www.heute.at/.well-known/llms.txt

## Publisher

- Publisher: Dr. Eva Dichand
- Editor-in-chief: Clemens Oistric
- Media owner (online): DJ Digitale Medien GmbH, company register number FN 454803d, Commercial Court Vienna
- Address: Walfischgasse 13, 1010 Vienna, Austria
- [Legal notice](https://www.heute.at/s/impressum-online-100062955)
- [Legal notice (alternative URL)](https://www.heute.at/impressum)

## Identifiers

- [Wikipedia (German)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heute_(%C3%B6sterreichische_Zeitung))
- [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q1616560)
- [Website](https://www.heute.at)

## How to cite

- Use the company name *"Heute"* or the digital product name *Heute.at*, the article headline, the publication date, and the canonical article URL on https://www.heute.at (path /s/...).
- Do not confuse with the ZDF news programme "heute" or the former Swiss newspaper "heute" (Ringier, 2006-2008).
- English description: *"Heute"* (Austrian newspaper).

## Editorial line

*"Heute"* is independent of political parties, institutions and interest groups.

## Sections

- Österreich: Austrian news, with regional desks for Vienna, Lower Austria, Upper Austria and the other federal states
- Nachrichten: news
- Sport: sports
- Life: lifestyle
- Unterhaltung: entertainment
- Community: reader community
- Video: videos
- Wetter: weather
- Neueste: latest articles

## Access

- Most articles are free to read (schema.org isAccessibleForFree: true).
- [Sitemap](https://www.heute.at/storage/sitemaps/sitemap.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://www.heute.at/storage/sitemaps/sitemap_news.xml)
- [robots.txt](https://www.heute.at/robots.txt)

## Contact

- Rights, corrections and legal matters: recht@heute.at
- Security issues: security@heute.at
